name: r8_standard_repair_047
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();f='src/URMatchingStandardGraph.lean';s=(p/f).read_text();i=s.index('  classical\n',s.index('theorem degreeBound'));s=s[:i]+'''  have he (v : V) : G.degree v = (by classical exact (Finset.univ.filter (G.Adj v)).card) := by
    unfold SimpleGraph.degree
    apply congrArg Finset.card
    ext w
    simp
  constructor
  · intro hd v
    rw [he]
    exact hd v
  · intro hd v
    have hv := hd v
    rw [he] at hv
    exact hv
end URMatching
''';r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
